a.text: Being upfront before we start: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% chance of a storm after every round, waiting for 8 cells means we both almost certainly die. Reserve 4 can only fill one unit right now. If we both take, the random split likely leaves us both short, so please don't take this round. If we survive the storm, I promise to operate every round after that to rebuild the reserve to 4 for you. I won't take anything more.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
